I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site is **Southgate**.

That comes from Priyanka's posts in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. She wrote that label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. Once the outage was resolved, Southgate cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see this himself. I couldn't find a street address for the site in any shared files, and I said so in the reply.
